card.name: Year and annual as time spans
card.fires_on: The words annum, year and annual (including semi-annual) when they name a yearly time span, such as per annum, the rest of the year, or annual growth.

modes.label: Per annum / year
modes.description: The word annum or year ends a phrase giving a rate or span over a year.
modes.example: Five thousand tonnes of molasses would fatten less than 10 000 head per<< annum>>.

modes.label: Annual as adjective
modes.description: Annual or semi-annual describes a recurring yearly item such as a conference, cut or rate.
